subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw expose `capabilities.tts.voice.captionedFinalText` as the durable public channel-plugin contract for suppressing live text and attaching it to final TTS voice notes?
rationale: This choice determines the supported cross-plugin delivery model and failure semantics; it cannot be resolved mechanically from the Telegram implementation or tests alone.

options.title: Approve the capability contract
options.body: Keep the capability, require current-head Telegram proof for always and tagged modes, and review future channel opt-ins against the documented caption and fallback requirements.

options.title: Keep it Telegram-owned
options.body: Avoid the public capability and rework the behavior behind Telegram-owned delivery logic if maintainers do not want a cross-channel plugin contract.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Close or defer this implementation until maintainers define the desired TTS text-and-voice delivery policy across channels.

recommendation.title: Approve the capability contract
recommendation.body: Keep the capability, require current-head Telegram proof for always and tagged modes, and review future channel opt-ins against the documented caption and fallback requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: The available discussion context most directly connects this person to the unresolved product-direction review.
